svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. Configure the database and AI credentials, start the default server after its database check, and test the real user journey. Automated tests support this verification but do not replace it. Deployment must also verify the live connection through the actual host. Mock AI avoids provider calls while leaving database work live.
svg.title: Running the app — prepare, start, and verify the journey
